_comment: Organism -> prebuilt STAR index on THIS cluster (organisms) + build-once reference URLs (reference_urls). Keys are NCBI scientific names (the SraRunTable 'Organism' value), matched case-insensitively. RECOMMENDED: fill organisms.<org>.index_dir with your cluster's prebuilt STAR index (must contain SAindex + Genome) to SKIP the heavy build-once step. gtf is optional (leave '' if the index was built WITH a GTF, the usual case). If index_dir is empty AND no GENOME_DIR is given, the pipeline builds an index once from reference_urls into STAR_INDEX_ROOT/<organism>.

homo sapiens.notes: Fill index_dir with your lab's GRCh38 STAR index path to avoid the build-once step.
